title: India bonds tiptoe along ahead of Fed meet; oil prices weigh - The Economic Times
text:
Indian government bonds traded range-bound early Wednesday as investors awaited the Fed's rate decision. Oil prices climbed, reviving concerns about the Gulf conflict and global economic impact. The Reserve Bank of India's policy decision is due next week, with rates expected to remain unchanged. India's financial conditions have tightened recently due to oil price surges. Economic growth is expected to slow while inflation surpasses the central bank's target.

Indian government bonds ended the day unchanged on Tuesday after a recent rally, as an influx of ten-year notes and the Federal Reserve's policy decision dampened risk appetite. Market participants kept a close eye on oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields for guidance. There is an expectation of a rate increase in September from the Federal Reserve, with geopolitical tensions lingering due to Oman's proposed fees in the Hormuz Strait.
